kings2.22.p1.b1.text: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years. …

kings2.22.p1.b2.text: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and walked in all the ways of his father David …

kings2.22.p1.b3.text: … he did not turn aside to the right or to the left.

kings2.22.p2.b1.text: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, King Josiah sent the scribe, Shaphan son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, to the house of the LORD, saying,

kings2.22.p2.b2.text: “Go up to Hilkiah the high priest and have him count the money that has been brought into the house of the LORD, which the doorkeepers have collected from the people.

kings2.22.p2.b3.text: And let them deliver it into the hands of the supervisors of those doing the work on the house of the LORD, who in turn are to give it to the workmen repairing the damages to the house of the LORD—

kings2.22.p2.b4.text: to the carpenters, builders, and masons—to buy timber and dressed stone to repair the temple.

kings2.22.p2.b5.text: But they need not account for the money put into their hands, since they work with integrity.”

kings2.22.p3.b1.text: Then Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe,

kings2.22.p3.b2.text: I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD!

kings2.22.p3.b3.text: And he gave it to Shaphan, who read it.

kings2.22.p3.b4.text: Hilkiah the priest has given me a book.

kings2.22.p4.b1.text: When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law,

kings2.22.p4.b3.text: and commanded Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Achbor son of Micaiah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the servant of the king:

kings2.22.p4.b4.text: “Go and inquire of the LORD for me, for the people, and for all Judah concerning the words in this book that has been found. For great is the wrath of the LORD that burns against us …

kings2.22.p5.b1.text: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went and spoke to Huldah the prophetess, … She lived in Jerusalem, in the Second District.

kings2.22.p5.b2.text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Tell the man who sent you

kings2.22.p5.b3.text: that this is what the LORD says: I am about to bring calamity on this place and on its people, according to all the words of the book that the king of Judah has read,

kings2.22.p5.b4.text: because they have forsaken Me and burned incense to other gods, … My wrath will be kindled against this place and will not be quenched.’

kings2.22.p6.b1.text: But as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, tell him that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘As for the words that you heard,

kings2.22.p6.b2.text: because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before the LORD … and because you have torn your clothes and wept before Me, I have heard you,’ declares the LORD.

kings2.22.p6.b3.text: ‘Therefore I will indeed gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the calamity that I will bring on this place.’”

kings2.22.p6.b4.text: So they brought her answer back to the king.
